title: The Queen of Sheba Visits Solomon
description: The Queen of Sheba travels to Jerusalem to test Solomon's wisdom with riddles, and is overwhelmed by his wisdom, wealth, and splendor at the court.

versions.title: The Queen of Sheba Visits Solomon
versions.description: The Queen of Sheba travels to Jerusalem to test Solomon's wisdom with difficult questions, and is overwhelmed by his knowledge, wealth, and splendor.
